subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should OpenClaw keep a persistent Dashboard header/breadcrumb workspace indicator for multi-agent chat, or should the newer no-breadcrumb topbar direction replace that surface?
rationale: The PR has credible proof for the focused breadcrumb behavior, but current main moved the touched files and a maintainer-authored draft removes the same header surface, so automation cannot choose the final UI contract.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Rebase this PR onto the current app/topbar/header paths and preserve a minimal workspace indicator while tracking optional issue ideas separately.

options.title: Adopt No-Breadcrumb Direction
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers choose the newer header-removal direction and design workspace certainty elsewhere.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Require the PR to prove a fuller active-agent/workspace/session target contract before the linked issue can close.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR onto the current app/topbar/header paths and preserve a minimal workspace indicator while tracking optional issue ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the current UI app/header migration that now owns the conflicting paths, making him the best available routing owner for the immediate product-surface decision.
